cohort: The study included 10,527 deliveries, comparing 188 pregnancies complicated by cardiovascular disease (CVD) with pregnancies without CVD.
finding: NHYA class III/IV in pregnant women with heart disease was significantly associated with decreased birth weight, premature birth, and increased maternal-neonatal mortality.
mod_finding: Vaginal delivery was the preferred mode of birth unless cardiac functions deteriorated to NHYA class III/IV.
birth_weight: Yes, decreased birth weight was a significant finding for NHYA class III/IV.
gest_age: Yes, premature birth was a significant finding for NHYA class III/IV.
